title: Python: resolve imports through a namespace directory mid-path (DEC-303 (a26) item 1)
description: Flask 49943b5a: self.m() with m defined in an in-repo base lands resolved-external/external-base because 'from .sansio.app import App' crosses src/flask/sansio/, a directory with no __init__.py; walkFrom in src/python/modules.ts returned namespace-package for the whole import. RULED by DEC-303 (a26) arm A: a namespace directory whose nearest regular-package ancestor is reached through namespace directories only has one portion, so resolve through it; a top-level namespace directory, a namespace directory as the last component, and a chain whose ancestor __init__.py touches __path__/extend_path/declare_namespace stay namespace-package. test/python-modules.test.ts:140 and :324 stay unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a flask-shaped fixture (a sansio directory lacking __init__.py, Flask(App) calling self.m()) is red before and green after, for the absolute import, the relative from-import and a module inside the namespace directory importing a sibling
a two-level namespace chain resolves; a regular package below a namespace directory resolves to its __init__
negative controls stay namespace-package: top-level namespace directory, namespace directory as last component, and an ancestor __init__.py with __path__ assignment, extend_path or declare_namespace
ADR 0008 carries an amendment naming DEC-303 (a26), and lore check --strict exits 0

implementationNotes: MEASUREMENT 2026-11-25 (read-only, src/python/calls.ts at origin/dev 57455f2, flask 49943b5a). Sites app.py:875, 1245, 1259 land external/external-base. Cause: src/flask/sansio/ has no __init__.py; 'from .sansio.app import App' returns namespace-package from walkFrom. MINIMAL FIXTURE (analyzePythonCalls): pkg/__init__.py; pkg/sansio/scaffold.py 'class Scaffold: def helper'; pkg/sansio/app.py 'from .scaffold import Scaffold; class App(Scaffold): def m'; pkg/app.py 'from .sansio.app import App; class Flask(App): def go(self): self.m()'. Without pkg/sansio/__init__.py: callBins resolvedInRepo 0, resolvedExternal 1; with it: resolvedInRepo 1 (edge to App.m). Same in a src/pkg layout. SPLIT ON FLASK: whole corpus (git ls-files *.py, 83 files) re-run with ONE synthetic empty src/flask/sansio/__init__.py (the only src/flask dir lacking one) moves callBins from {resolvedInRepo 833, resolvedExternal 1352, receiverNeedsInference 1587, nameNotBound 189} to {1054, 1125, 1596, 186}: +221 in-repo, -227 external. So 227 of flask's 1352 resolved-external sites are namespace-caused; the rest of the external-base sites are genuine external bases. The 282 external-base figure came from the instrumented meas-fix copy and is not split directly; 227 is the measured effect of the one directory. Pinned tests: test/python-modules.test.ts:140 and :324. Ruling requested via the leader; no code until it arrives.

FIX 2026-11-25 (DEC-303 (a26) item 1). modules.ts: walkFrom continues through a namespace directory when a regular-package anchor exists, is not at the last component and its __init__.py does not name __path__/extend_path/declare_namespace (new ModuleData.pathManipulated, conservative: a read of __path__ counts); resolveRelative resolves a module part from inside a namespace directory by the same anchor rule. REAL-FIX FLASK MEASUREMENT (git ls-files *.py, 83 files, 49943b5a): callBins {inRepo 833, external 1352, needsInference 1587, nameNotBound 189} -> {1054, 1125, 1596, 186}, identical to the synthetic-__init__ run; instrumented copy: external-base sites 282 -> 55, so 227 namespace-caused and 55 genuine external bases. RESIDUALS (not in the ruling): a dotted attribute chain through a namespace directory (class C(pkg.ns.mod.Base) after import pkg.ns.mod) still does not resolve; from . import x inside a namespace directory stays namespace-package. Red commit e556a57.

ROUND 1 REVIEW FIXES (reviewer CHANGES-REQUESTED at 06bf1228). (1) modules.ts: an import statement naming extend_path or declare_namespace (aliased included) or star-importing pkgutil/pkg_resources marks pathManipulated. (2) a file with a parse error is treated as manipulated. (3) ADR wording now matches this note: from . import x and its absolute twin from pkg.ns import mod, and the dotted attribute chain (GCLI-92), are residuals not ruled, behaviour unchanged. (4) new fixtures: extend_path without a __path__ token, aliased declare_namespace and extend_path, star import from pkgutil, unparseable region, non-empty realistic ancestor positive control, from ..x import y through a namespace dir; mutation checks each turned exactly the predicted case red (dropping extend_path from the name set: 1; dropping the import regex: 3; dropping the hasError line: 1; flagging every identifier: the positive control). (5) residual filed as GCLI-92. RED-BEFORE COUNT: red commit e556a57 had 6 failing module fixtures and 2 failing call fixtures (8); the sibling-import module test was added with the fix and was never red-before; the remaining module fixtures there are negative controls that pass before and after.
